verdict.rationale: Luma's homepage claims its agents can generate and refine across video, image, audio, and text, which suggests audio generation within the same platform. That is a single, thin marketing mention. Nothing describes sound effects, ambient audio, or music being generated to match a scene, and the Ray/API docs list only video features. missing for 10: documented scene-matched SFX/ambient/music generation, details of how audio attaches to generated clips, API or docs coverage of audio, independent or hands-on corroboration.
